IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Pager: elevated error rate detected in embeddings -> reranker flow (route: /v2/embed-batch -> rerank-v1). Validation errors 15-22% across several tenants. First seen 2026-02-20T14:02Z. Paging oncall.

Maya (oncall): I'm on it. Paging eng-ml and infra. Sam can you take post-handoff if needed?

Aaron L (eng-ml): I'm up. Quick glance at reranker logs shows a flood of `invalid_vector_length` and `schema_mismatch` around 14:05Z. Pulling embedder batch logs and samples now.

Aaron L: paste:```
[14:04:59] ERROR reranker.consumer: invalid vector length: received=1536 expected=1280 | shard=3 | batch=0x9c
[14:05:01] WARN embed.batch: payload_size=61440 expected_bytes=51200; metadata_len=1280
```

Julie D (devops): infra checks: no node churn, k8s events clean, svc mesh healthy. No network packet loss. No infra deploys in the last 12h.

Carly S (support): customer triage: 6 customers impacted, heavy on BetaCorp (prod) and two internal test tenants. BetaCorp reports brief degraded quality and 502s for rerank. I'll open customer-facing updates.

Sam H: handoff in 12 min. Maya, if you need me to lead mitigation after initial triage, say so.

Maya (oncall): please do. Aaron, gather any concrete evidence linking embedder image or model change to output size. Also collect sample payloads and pod image IDs.

Aaron L: running commands:```
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=embedder -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.name} {.spec.containers[0].image}\n'
```
result: embedder-1 redwood/embedder:2026-02-20-canary-1, embedder-2 redwood/embedder:2026-02-10-stable, embedder-3 redwood/embedder:2026-02-20-canary-1

Aaron L: grepping logs per pod shows bad vector lengths come from pods running the `2026-02-20-canary-1` image. Stable pods produce expected 1280-dim vectors. Evidence attached: sample log snippets and base64 payloads.

CI-Pipeline (bot): Deploy job `embedder:canary` completed at 2026-02-20T13:58Z -> staged canary=40% (note: manual override of canary percent in pipeline).

Julie D: that explains exposure. That config should have been 10%. I'll look at the deployment pipeline and rollback the canary image from the batch cluster.

Aaron L: hypothesis tracker:
- H1: Model artifact in canary image uses different hidden size (1536) -> vectors larger than expected -> downstream validation fails. (logs + model config diff show hidden_size mismatch)
- H2: Serialization/packing change in canary codepath concatenates tensors or pads incorrectly for certain batch sizes. (some warnings about truncating tensors seen)
- H3: Edge network fragmentation causing partial payloads (low confidence; metrics show network ok)

Maya (oncall): let's validate H1 quickly by extracting model config from both images. Aaron?

Aaron L: done. `docker run --rm redwood/embedder:2026-02-20-canary-1 cat /opt/model/config.json` -> shows `hidden_size: 1536`, `quantize_bits: 8`. Stable image `2026-02-10-stable` has `hidden_size: 1280`. That lines up.

Sam H: mitigation options: rollback canary to stable (fast), route traffic away from canary pods (possible via k8s service/selector tweak), or patch embedder to validate output dims and reject. Fastest is rollback. Julie, can you execute?

Julie D: executing rollback to stable now. Command:```
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/embedder embedder=redwood/embedder:2026-02-10-stable && kubectl rollout status deploy/embedder -n inference --watch
```
Monitoring metrics and logs.

RerankService (bot): ALERT: reranker validation_errors spiked to 21% at 14:06Z.

Julie D: rollback in progress -> pods terminating and new pods using stable image coming up.

RerankService (bot): ALERT: validation_errors for rerank-v1 dropping to 1.2% over last 5m.

Carly S (support): BetaCorp reports partial recovery; errors went from 25% to 3% in their sample. I'm sending a customer note and tracking health.

Maya (oncall): switching incident state to MITIGATED when errors <1% sustained for 10m. Aaron, collect the bad payloads and the model artifacts; Sam, start the RCA doc timeline. Julie, file a CI change to default canary to 10%.

Aaron L: sample failed payload (trimmed):```
{
  "batch_id": "0x9c",
  "vectors": [ {"len":1536, "data":"<base64>..."}, {"len":1536, "data":"<base64>..."} ],
  "metadata": {"expected_len":1280}
}
```
Note: metadata sometimes incorrectly reports expected_len=1280 while vector bytes correspond to 1536 floats -> downstream truncation attempted causing `invalid vector length` errors.

Sam H: draft timeline (UTC):
- 13:58 deploy canary `2026-02-20-canary-1` (CI)
- 14:04 anomalies start (reranker logs show validation errors)
- 14:06 pager triggered by error spike
- 14:12 triage pinpoints embedder canary pods as source
- 14:20 rollback decision and actioned
- 14:23 rollback completes; errors start falling
- 14:32 errors drop below 1% -> mitigated

Julie D: root cause summary so far: incorrect model artifact (hidden_size mismatch) published in the canary image combined with a CI canary traffic misconfiguration (40% instead of default 10%) which increased customer exposure.

Aaron L: proposed action items:
- Short: enforce strict output-dim validation in embedder runtime and fail fast (owner: eng-ml). Add immediate alert on vector_size_mismatch metric.
- Short: change CI canary default to 10% and block manual overrides without approval in production pipelines (owner: devops).
- Medium: add CI integration test that loads model binary and verifies output dims on a canonical input before tagging image as canary (owner: eng-ml + CI).
- Long: reranker defensive parsing: schema validation and graceful fallback with degraded rank ordering and better customer-facing error codes (owner: eng-platform).

Maya (oncall): I'm making an incident ticket update with mitigation, impact, and action items. Sam will lead the RCA writeup; schedule postmortem for tomorrow.

Sam H: I'll draft the incident report with timelines, logs, command snippets, and the diffs between model configs. Will include customer impact numbers (6 customers, ~3.1k failed requests over 30m).

Carly S (support): PR to customer comms ready; tracking responses and will escalate if any customer opens an urgent ticket.

Aaron L: attaching extra evidence for RCA: `git sha` of model bundle pushed in canary, model config diff showing hidden_size 1536 -> 1280 change, and sample base64 payloads.

Julie D: opened CI change PR: `ci/pipelines/embedder.yml` -> set default_canary_percent: 10 and add a gating approval step for >20%. PR link: <https://git.redwood/ci/PR-789>.

Maya (oncall): IncidentBot set status MITIGATED at 2026-02-20T14:35Z. Closing handoff. Thanks team.

IncidentBot: incident record updated: INC-1920012345. Follow-up: RCA meeting scheduled 2026-02-21 15:00 UTC.
